title: Chilli Con Carne #2
preamble:
3 onions, diced

1 tbsp tomato puree, or 1/2 bottle of pasata

400g packet chopped tomatoes

1 tbsp drinking chocolate

1kg minced beef, extra lean
ingredients: 1 tbsp tomato puree, or 1/2 bottle of pasata
2 sweet red peppers, chopped into large pieces
1 handful fresh herbs, eg: mint, basil, parsley. Chopped
method: Brown the mince in a heavy pan. Add all the other ingredients except the carrots and herbs.
Simmer for 1-2 hours (adding a little water if necessary).
Serve your chilli con carne with rice or a baked potato.
